question: How does this approach compares to the state-of-the-art results on these tasks?
title: Contextual Joint Factor Acoustic Embeddings
answer_short: The CJFA encoder performs significantly better than the VAE baseline and CJFS encoder on both phone classification and speaker recognition tasks, with up to 3% relative gain on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition.
answer_rationale: Text 4 explicitly states that the CJFA encoder outperforms both the VAE baseline and CJFS encoder, with gains of up to 3% on phone classification and 3–6% on speaker recognition. Text 2 and Text 3 further support this by showing CJFA's superior performance across tasks and configurations, while Text 6 confirms the comparison against baselines and the use of TIMIT data for evaluation.
